'''''Busteromuchmacho and the Vermillion Shadow''''' was Volume 3 in the ''[[Squib Jedi]]'' children's [[Holobook/Legends|holobook]] series.

A copy was found in the possession of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] scavenging the ruins of [[Almas Academy]] after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
